image_description: A close-up, vertical crop of a wooden wind instrument, identified as a bassoon. The image shows the upper joint and part of the boot joint against a plain grey fabric background. Visible features include the reddish-brown polished wood grain, silver-plated metal keys (specifically a trill key and a lever mechanism), and the metal bocal inserted into the top of the wing joint. The bell is not visible in this frame.

To detect subtle texture anomalies in the wood grain or metal reflections that might indicate AI generation artifacts.
To ensure the metal keys are physically connected to the wood without melting or boundary bleeding.
